data.name: Category_Markup
data.value: Markup (Web Forms, Razor, HTML, XML, XAML)

data.name: Setting_CleanupOnSave_Description
data.value: Clean each document right before it is saved.

data.name: Setting_RemoveUnusedLocalVariables_Description
data.value: C#: CS0168 / CS0219. VB: BC42024 / BC42099. Only when the value has no side effects. Skipped when the file has compile errors.

data.name: Setting_RemoveUnusedUsings_Description
data.value: C#: CS8019. VB: BC50000 / BC50001. Skipped when the file has compile errors.

data.name: Setting_SortUsings_Description
data.value: System.* first, then alphabetical. C#: global → normal → static → alias. VB: normal → alias → XML.

data.name: Setting_RemoveConsecutiveBlankLines_Description
data.value: Keeps at most the configured number of blank lines in a row. Applies to every file type. Never touches strings, template strings, disabled code, <pre>, <textarea>, <script> or CDATA.

data.name: Setting_MaxConsecutiveBlankLines_Description
data.value: Blank lines allowed in a row (0 removes them all).

data.name: Setting_RemoveLeadingBlankLines_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines at the start of the file

data.name: Setting_RemoveTrailingBlankLines_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines at the end of the file

data.name: Setting_TrimTrailingWhitespace_Description
data.value: Applies to every file type. Never touches strings, template strings, disabled code, <pre>, <textarea>, <script> or CDATA.

data.name: Setting_SingleFinalNewline_Title
data.value: Exactly one newline at the end of the file

data.name: Setting_SingleFinalNewline_Description
data.value: Adds it when missing and removes extra ones. Applies to every file type.

data.name: Setting_IncludeCSharp_Description
data.value: Cleaned with Roslyn, in the background and in parallel.

data.name: Setting_IncludeVisualBasic_Description
data.value: Cleaned with Roslyn, in the background and in parallel.

data.name: Setting_EditorFormatted_Description
data.value: Formatted with the Visual Studio editor.

data.name: Setting_AdditionalFileExtensions_Description
data.value: Extensions not covered by the groups above, formatted with the Visual Studio editor. Separate with ';' (e.g. .skin;.sitemap).

data.name: Setting_IgnoreGeneratedCode_Description
data.value: Skips *.designer.cs, *.g.cs, files under obj\ and files marked <auto-generated>.

data.name: Setting_ExcludeT4GeneratedCode_Description
data.value: Skips files that have a .tt template with the same name.

data.name: Setting_ExcludePatterns_Description
data.value: Files whose full path matches any expression are skipped. Separate with ';'.

data.name: Setting_RegenerateWebFormsDesigner_Title
data.value: Regenerate Web Forms designer after formatting

data.name: Setting_RegenerateWebFormsDesigner_Description
data.value: After formatting .aspx/.ascx/.master files, regenerates their .designer.cs with 'Convert to Web Application' so they stay in sync with the markup (Web Application projects only).

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesAfterOpenBlock_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines after opening a block

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesAfterOpenBlock_Description
data.value: After '{' in C#; after Sub, If, For, Class… in VB.

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesBeforeCloseBlock_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines before closing a block

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesBeforeCloseBlock_Description
data.value: Before '}' in C#; before End, Next, Loop, Else, Catch… in VB.

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesBetweenChainedCalls_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines between chained calls

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesBetweenChainedCalls_Description
data.value: Lines that start with '.Method()' in C#.

data.name: Setting_BlankLineBetweenMembers_Description
data.value: Adds one when missing, for the member types below.

data.name: Setting_BlankLineBetweenMemberKinds_Title
data.value: Member types separated by a blank line

data.name: Setting_BlankLineBetweenMemberKinds_Description
data.value: Separate with ';'. Available: Fields, Constructors, Properties, Methods, Events, Enums, Types.

data.name: Setting_BlankLineBeforeCase_Description
data.value: Every case / Case except the first one.

data.name: Setting_BlankLineBeforeSingleLineComments_Description
data.value: Not after opening a block, another comment, a directive or a case label.

data.name: Setting_ReorganizeMembers_Title
data.value: Reorganize members by type and access

data.name: Setting_ReorganizeMembers_Description
data.value: Fields keep their relative order. Structs, [StructLayout] types and types with directives between members are not touched.

data.name: Setting_MemberKindOrder_Description
data.value: Separate with ';'. Missing types go last.

data.name: Setting_UniformAccessors_Title
data.value: Accessors all single-line or all multi-line

data.name: Setting_UniformAccessors_Description
data.value: C# only. Single-line when every accessor has at most one statement.

data.name: Setting_WrapComments_Description
data.value: Splits single-line comments longer than the width. Never joins lines.

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesInsideTags_Title
data.value: Remove blank lines right inside a tag

data.name: Setting_RemoveBlankLinesInsideTags_Description
data.value:
After
and before
. Never inside 
,

data.name: Setting_IncludeSql_Description
data.value: Cleaned in the background, without opening editors (also in SSMS 22.7+).

data.name: Setting_FormatSql_Description
data.value: ScriptDOM, the same engine as the SSMS 22.7+ formatter. Options come from .editorconfig [*.sql] with the same keys as SSMS (keyword_casing, indentation_size…). Files with syntax errors or SQLCMD are not formatted.

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_AsKeywordOnOwnLine
data.value: AS keyword on its own line

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_MultilineGroupByElementsList
data.value: GROUP BY elements on separate lines

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_MultilineOrderByElementsList
data.value: ORDER BY elements on separate lines

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_MultilinePartitionByElementsList
data.value: PARTITION BY elements on separate lines

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_MultilineNestedFunctionCalls
data.value: Nested function call parameters on separate lines

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_MultilineWithOptionsList
data.value: WITH / OPTION options on separate lines

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_NewLineBeforeOpenParenthesisInMultilineList
data.value: New line before '(' in multi-line lists

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_NewLineBeforeCloseParenthesisInMultilineList
data.value: New line before ')' in multi-line lists

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_NumNewlinesAfterBatchStatement
data.value: New lines after a batch statement

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_SpaceBetweenDataTypeAndParameters
data.value: Space between data type and parameters

data.name: Setting_SqlFmt_SpaceBetweenParametersInDataType
data.value: Space between parameters in data types
